title: Two-stage anaerobic digestion performance and feed characterization for perennial ryegrass silage
geography: Study affiliations in Germany; feed harvest origin is not reported in the article
source_location: Methods: reactor set-up and sampling; Results: biogas reactor performance and long-term microbial dynamics; Fig. 2
license_or_rights: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), as stated in the article
reuse_constraint: Reference evidence only; not a GreenHub feed or reactor default
data_handling: Transcribed only values stated in the article text and figure description. The reported plus/minus spread was retained without labeling it as standard deviation or confidence interval because the article passage does not identify the statistic. L_N is retained as the authors' normal-volume notation; the methods define it at 0 °C and 1013 hPa.
limitations: Feed is perennial ryegrass silage, not fresh roadside grass, GreenHub VARTA grass, press cake, or post-protein residual.
The experiment uses a two-stage two-phase system with batch downflow hydrolysis and an upflow anaerobic filter, not GreenHub's active single-stage empirical CSTR model.
The article does not report an unambiguous continuous OLR in kg VS/m3/d in the extracted passage; the 500 g and 1500 g conditions are not converted to OLR.
The reported 28-day value is retained as batch-fermentation retention time and is not relabeled as CSTR HRT.
Only selected system-level methane yields are stated in the article text; no missing replicate value is interpolated.
This source does not calibrate GreenHub hydrolysis fractions, methane conversion, ammonia inhibition, heating, mixing, or reactor scale-up.
